# Ours Privacy

Ours Privacy is a Data Infrastructure and Analytics company. Ours Privacy is a HIPAA-compliant CDP + privacy platform that unlocks optimized ads and analytics while making sure sensitive data never reaches non-compliant tools. Ours Privacy employs 32 people (+166.7% YoY, +20 people). Headquartered in Houston, Texas, United States.

## About

We believe that you shouldn’t have to choose between growth and patient privacy. Our HIPAA-compliant customer data platform enables marketers to use best in class tools - GTM, GA4, Google Ads, Meta, and more - without sacrificing patient privacy. Our CDP removes PHI so you can optimize every step of your funnel with confidence.

Ours Privacy is built by experts in healthcare, martech, and security, helping you scale responsibly, with confidence. We're lucky to be backed by an experienced group of investors, including Serena Ventures, Adam Grant, Lakehouse, Andy Dunn, TMV, Bullish, Collab Fund, GreyMatter, Switch Ventures and more.

# Privacy Company

Privacy Company is a Legal Services company. Privacy Company offers user-friendly software, in-depth training, and specialized consulting services. Privacy Company employs 52 people (+15.6% YoY, +7 people). Headquartered in The Hague, South Holland, Netherlands, with presence in United States.
